name: montycloud-e2e-tooling
description: Node-side tooling for the MontyCloud E2E suite: the Allure 3 report CLI. Python (pytest+pytest-bdd) is the test framework. UI authoring uses the Python `playwright` CLI (`playwright codegen`) and optionally `npx @playwright/mcp@latest` for interactive MCP clients.

scripts.report:clean: node -e "for (const d of ['allure-results', 'allure-report']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
